Links:
- E1 → E3 (supports).
- E2 → E4 (supports).
Link kinds: 'requires', 'supports', 'causes', 'blocks', 'enables' and 'derived_from' carry influence from the first entity to the second; 'informs' and 'references' do not carry influence. An 'influencing link into X' means one of the first kind ending at X.

- coverage of E3 = ([capacity of E1, counted only while E1 has an influencing link into E3; otherwise undefined] ÷ required of E3).
- coverage of E4 = ([capacity of E2, counted only while E2 has an influencing link into E4; otherwise undefined] ÷ required of E4).
- status of E3 is "FULL" if (coverage of E3 ≥ 1); "INVALID" if (coverage of E3 ≤ 0); otherwise "PARTIAL".
- status of E4 is "FULL" if (coverage of E4 ≥ 1); "INVALID" if (coverage of E4 ≤ 0); otherwise "PARTIAL".
